title: Renames Pack V1
description: Rename vanilla items in an anvil to unlock custom textures and 3D models. Supports all tool materials, bows, maces, and more.
body:
![all item in the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e24cab1e553449080a6a47d227e1383a85e69ec9.png)# Renames Pack V1

Rename vanilla items in an anvil to unlock custom textures and 3D models.

## Features

- 🎨 Custom textures
- 🧊 3D models made with Blockbench
- 🪓 Supports all tool materials
- 🏹 Custom bows with draw animations
- 🔨 Custom maces
- ⚡ Easy to use: just rename your item

## Rename Sets

- sulfure
- azalea
- rascal
- ametyst
- glass
- no texture

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.5+
- Fabric
